description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.
